designationHistory.indexText: Congress directed the Secretary of the Interior to establish the King Range National Conservation Area in California.
designationHistory.note: The act 'authorized and directed' the Secretary to establish the area after further steps, rather than establishing it outright; the BLM page dates the designation to 1970.

sources.name: Public Law 91-476, 84 Stat. 1067 (govinfo, Statutes at Large)
